name: stock-market-dashboard
description: Full-stack paper-trading platform for NSE/BSE and NASDAQ/NYSE. Simulated trading only.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
